fieldNotes.truckGate: The large east-side truck yard is enclosed by chain-link fence (confirmed in multiple 2023-2025 Street Views) with a single wide driveway opening off Jurupa Ave at the SE corner - a controlled fenced enclosure with one pinch-point entrance. A sliding gate at the opening is implied by the perimeter fence but could not be positively resolved in imagery; classed truckGate true with medium confidence.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth structure visible at the truck-yard entrance in z21 satellite or Street View.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: True - a fenced/controlled truck-yard entrance with no guard booth implies kiosk/app check-in.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Main dock bank on the east face fronting the truck yard, plus a separate smaller dock area on the SW face - two distinct dock clusters.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock bank on the east face (~35-40 doors) plus a small SW dock area; ~45 doors total estimated - low confidence.
fieldNotes.dropArea: East truck yard is large but held only a few trailers in 2026 imagery; no dense marked drop-trailer stalls.
fieldNotes.dropYard: The fenced east truck yard functions as a dedicated trailer-storage / staging lot.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep open paved truck yard between the gate opening and the east dock face; ample queuing room for 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide entrance and a largely empty truck yard leave abundant room to add an express lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Site is in the dense Fontana / Inland Empire warehouse district, surrounded on all sides by large distribution buildings; clearly Urban.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur; a flood-control channel (not rail) borders the east side of the truck yard.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Estimated from perimeter box (~323m x ~369m) covering the building, east truck yard, and south parking.
fieldNotes.facilityNote: Racklify lists the Fontana CJ facility at 250,430 sq ft. CJ Logistics America operates a 3PL/fulfillment DC here; a B&G Foods FSIS-inspected establishment is associated with CJ Logistics America in Fontana.
